protocol.training: Full FP32 weights/AdamW, BF16 autocast, no decay, clip1. Completion-token summed NLL divided by fixed8*batch_size, including exact raw sampled tokens for direct self-imitation. Natural LM head, no added head.
protocol.targets: Reasoning arms sample4complete candidates at temperature1 with identical RNG schedules. Plurality over parsed final integers, first-occurrence tie break, no correctness/confidence filter. Teach the direct prompt the canonical boxed plurality answer. Entirely invalid groups contribute zero target tokens; all prompts and sampling costs still count.
protocol.frozen_source: A fresh independent group from the initial model at each scheduled practice presentation; all groups may be precomputed before updates. Targets are not reused from a fixed per-question bank. Only the corresponding causal prefix enters learning/cost attribution.
protocol.direct_control: Sample1current-model short completion at temperature1 and train on its actual tokens. No answer canonicalization or correctness selection. Multiple finite-batch updates can move it; zero expected initial score is not a claim of unchanged realized weights.
protocol.primary: On-policy-minus-frozen-source short-answer accuracy at384practice presentations, across3optimization seeds and144paired fresh questions. This is a consolidation pilot; no exponent selection or fitting.
protocol.secondary: Short and reasoning accuracy at all checkpoints; training-question accuracy; target correctness graded only after completion; all generation/training compute. Improved short accuracy alone does not establish improved information or an on-policy advantage.
protocol.icl: Initial model only: first4and16frozen-source practice examples, either selected answer text or the selected sampled reasoning trace, in context. Evaluate both direct and reasoning modes on the same held-out questions. Seed68000 only; exploratory, not an independent statistical replication.
protocol.resources: Institutional gpu_lowp only. No paid APIs. Save final weights for seed68000 only to configured fast cache; archive before releasing allocations.

bootstrap: 3000 paired resamples of3optimization seeds and144questions, stratified by depth; task cohorts fixed. Three seeds limit precision.
